Name: Prompts_01_FirstSightGranary
overlord_bark: Their whole winter, goblin, stacked in one shed and guarded like a crown. Unstack it.
hud_line: Granary — burn it. One of your three burn targets. Torch toss: Q.

Name: Prompts_02_FirstSightWheatField
overlord_bark: Look at all that ripe, well-fed smugness. One spark, and it walks the rows on its own.
hud_line: Wheat field — fire spreads row to row. One of your three burn targets. Torch toss: Q.

Name: Prompts_03_FirstSightWindmill
overlord_bark: The county's proudest silhouette, turning away up there. Put a torch to her frame.
hud_line: Windmill — torch the frame to set it Ablaze. Torch toss: Q.

Name: Prompts_04_WindmillStage1Ablaze
overlord_bark: Her skin's alight, goblin, but it's the dust in her belly that'll bring her down — put fire through a window.
hud_line: Windmill: Ablaze — needs a window shot. Aimed torch: Q.

Name: Prompts_05_FirstSightPatrol
overlord_bark: Torches in the trees. Fold yourself into the hedge — a hamlet that suspects nothing keeps napping.
hud_line: Patrol ahead — break their sightline to stay unconfirmed. Crouch.

Name: Prompts_06_FirstSightUnawareGuard
overlord_bark: Behind him. Closer. He is thinking about his supper. Let that be the last thing he does.
hud_line: Unaware human — take him down in silence. Hold E behind him.

Name: Prompts_07_FirstSightCivilianUnarmed
overlord_bark: Don't spill her, goblin. Rope her. A corpse is a tantrum; a prisoner is tribute.
hud_line: Unarmed civilian — bind for a captive instead of a corpse. Hold E.

Name: Prompts_08_FirstSightWarHorn
overlord_bark: Enough creeping. Blow, and hear my children come out of the trees for you.
hud_line: War-horn — 3–4 goblins sprint in from the treeline. Blow: G.

Name: Prompts_09_FirstSightLivestockPen
overlord_bark: Their wealth has trotters, goblin. Send a lad — he'll chase it down and carry it home on his back.
hud_line: Pig in the pen — a goblin couriers it home for 40 loot. Point.
